title: Jenkins diagnosis skill
summary: Investigate the first actionable failure with build and revision context.

sections.label: Inputs
sections.text: Jenkins run identity, candidate revision, failed stage, relevant logs/reports, environment, and recent changes.

sections.label: Procedure
sections.text: Locate the first actionable error; distinguish implementation, fixture, environment, access, and infrastructure causes; inspect relevant source; propose the smallest supported next step.

sections.label: Output
sections.text: Finding, evidence, cause confidence, verification performed, and next action.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: A proposed cause is supported by the actual failure. Repeated retries stop when no new evidence appears.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
